subject: stf
title: STF.------IST.S.ALGN.
description: Second diagram on page 465, paired with the IST-F × AFL-DY × AFI triple-crossing above. Where the first diagram shows the three-axis exclusion-of-no-one route, this one closes by structurally showing where the artist's structural-form has to land if the political-creativity relationship the prose names is to hold: (C)STF (the concept of source transfer) is crossed with IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment). STF sits at top-center with the subject-arrow; a single bent line runs down from it through PROG-CONT (progressional continuance), APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions) and IST-F (isolated focus), each at a bend, to IST-S-ALGN at the bottom-right as the partner-axis terminus. PROJ-CONT (projectional continuance) branches right from the STF–PROG-CONT stretch, so it reads from PROG-CONT; CUL-TF-S (cultural transfer shifts) and ALT-D (alternative definitions) branch right and left from the PROG-CONT–APP-RDEF stretch, so they read from APP-RDEF.
